scope: Inactive typed Owner-register adapter; actual Chromium IndexedDB/WebCrypto; fictional HTTP authority; not product/Clerk/provider/independent-security proof

checks.name: Import has no database, network, credential or product activation side effects
18-player basis and 17-mark original/local overlay commit together; exact canonical wire and IDs retained
Private roster, names, captured time and original payload encrypted at rest; persisted keys non-extractable
30 covered actual local reads while disconnected use zero key or operating requests
Actual browser-process restart automatically reopens encrypted rows and original without another credential/key exchange
Replacement, foreign academy, duplicate players and saved-mark wire versions cannot alter the original
Dispatch is journalled Unknown first; retries use byte-identical wire; wrong count/event/op/extra receipt fields cannot settle it
Exact count-only receipt settles once and invalidates current basis without fabricating fresh marks/totals; confirmed outcome survives absent follow-up read
Indexed original discovery survives reopening without a remembered operation ID; confirmed originals remain discoverable
Definitive deadline refusal retains Needs review and blocks blind retry/replacement while unrelated events remain usable
Active event lookup supplies the exact local marks/display basis separately from server records and retained refusal
A transfer begun before a confirmed save cannot later replace its invalidated basis with pre-save rows
Paged import resumes across reload with durable cursor; bad cursor/header preserve prior complete generation; final page switches coverage atomically
Abandoning only a staged transfer preserves the active generation and removes its staged rows without touching pending work
Bounded local pages can combine smaller byte-bounded API pages without falsely rejecting long Arabic names
Complete-empty and not-prepared data are distinct; counts are validated from the complete transfer
Non-Owner projections, closed bases and already-saved roster players cannot become a new offline register
Duplicate rows, incomplete terminal pages and unexpected private fields never activate coverage
Real page and original transactions abort without false local acknowledgement, partial coverage or partial pending overlay
Aborted settlement preserves Unknown and prior basis; receipt/invalidated projection commit together on retry
1000 Unicode players prepare in 20 bounded server-shaped pages, reopen in at most 50 rows and preserve the full 1000-mark canonical packet
Competing connections capture exactly one unsettled original for the same event without duplicate partial writes
Cleanup failure leaves a durable Cleaning fence across reload; completed logout removes replica material and retains protected original
Independent stored-key inspection after cleanup finds no read/recovery key; remaining device key opens only the outer wrap and cannot unwrap the retained data key
Other fictional account is refused by HTTP authority; wrong recovery material fails cryptographically; original account recovers pending work without restoring removed replicas
Invoked 30-day cleanup uses the same protected-recovery boundary; no idle lock, expiry timer or automatic purge of pending work
First-ever activation reserves a durable fence before key delivery; logout rejects a late valid reply even before downloads exist
Wrong academy, subject, device and field epoch cannot open, activate or clean another scope; ciphertext is retained
Known denial quarantines current replicas and pending access; old handles cannot use retained cached material
Disposal during asynchronous decryption prevents a late private value from returning to the old workspace
Scope disposal immediately after a disk commit suppresses the obsolete acknowledgement while durable original discovery survives reopening
Ciphertext tampering is rejected without resetting or deleting retained operation discovery
Missing persisted key refuses opening/reactivation and never replaces keys over existing work
Missing control metadata with orphaned encrypted data refuses destructive reinitialization
Injected storage unavailability produces no plaintext fallback or false local acknowledgement; real quota exhaustion remains unmeasured
Write acknowledgement requires supported strict transaction durability; a weaker reported mode is refused without fallback
Two independently activated fictional academy/account namespaces retain separate roster and original indexes without cross-reading
Newer schema fences an older adapter without database reset; actual forward migration is not claimed

limitations: No product route imports or private activation; no actual account/Clerk/current Owner/device registration or protected server key custody
Paged current API has no globally coherent snapshot; complete local transfer is not simultaneous freshness
No automatic 30-day trusted-clock trigger, forward schema migration, real disk exhaustion/eviction recovery, cross-device or hosted cold offline boot
Local timing includes Playwright round trips on isolated loopback; no app/provider p75/p95 or achieved quota savings
Same-origin scripts with available keys can use them; no hardware isolation or secure-erasure claim
No live command upload, background scheduler, cancellation reconcile, private enablement, access grant or production release; independent security remains open
